label: RTY NY open gap fade (February filter)
researchSummary: Tests whether the overnight gap fades or continues during a specific NY cash-session window. Filtered by signalMonth=2. Upgraded to a distinct 2:1 planned reward-to-risk variant because the time-exit entry/exit path preserves forward PF versus the legacy 1R accounting baseline.
selectionMethod: Pre-2022 train-score rank, then post-2022 forward qualification. No parameters were fit on post-2022 data.
verificationSummary: Verified by backtest-engine runner output: PF 2.85, 59 trades, 49.07R total. RR comparison accepted: baseline PF 2.85 vs 2R PF 2.85, 59 trades.
